prompt: A login form has a user field, a password field, a button, and a status label. Complete the listener: both fields non-empty gives "welcome <user>", otherwise "missing input".
explanation: JPasswordField is a JTextField subclass whose text is read through getPassword(), which returns a char[] rather than a String so sensitive data is not interned; new String(chars) converts it when you need string operations. The listener validates both inputs before acting -- a very common GUI pattern -- and reports the result through a status label instead of a dialog, which keeps the panel testable.
hints: Read the user name with user.getText() and the password with new String(pass.getPassword()).
Use isEmpty() on both strings and combine the two conditions with &&.
One if/else that calls status.setText(...) in each branch is all you need.
